question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hades is the god of the underworld and __wealth__ in Greek mythology.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Riches**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Wealth**' refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money. (धन)

 
 
• **Example**: His hard work and smart investments led to his considerable **wealth**.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym here is '**riches**'. '**Riches**' also refers to material wealth, an abundance of valuable resources or material possessions. (धन-सम्पदा)
 
 
• **Example**: The ancient shipwreck held unfathomable **riches**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**wealth**' is '**riches**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: '**Sterility**' primarily means the quality or condition of being unable to produce offspring. (बांझपन)
 
• Option 3: '**Debts**' refers to the money that is owed or due. (ऋण)
 
• Option 4: '**Shades**' generally refer to dark figures or images cast by an object blocking light. (छाया)
